manifest.name: A module that claims nothing
sources: the manifest-only case: a legitimate module with no metric, no engine field and no derivation. A validator must accept it, and this is the first vector it should be held to

derives.expr: CASE WHEN map_kpa < 255 AND baro_kpa > 0 THEN (map_kpa - baro_kpa) * 0.1450377 END
derives.note: null, never zero, when MAP is saturated or baro is unknown: a saturated reading is not a measurement of 0 psi
